snippet.title: Roots of Fury - Official Gameplay Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Roots of Fury, a co-op dungeon crawling hack-and-slash RPG developed by knit'n'purl game studio and Turing Studio. Players will find themselves as a shrunken down scientist who takes the fight to the bugs compromising the roots of her dear plant. Craft weapons, team up with ants, and attack the bugs in Roots of Fury, coming soon to PC (Steam).
